tools.name: shipmonk_list_warehouses
tools.description: List the enabled ShipMonk warehouses for the account behind this API key, with their short codes (e.g. CZ1, PA1). Good first call. API: GET /v1/integrations/warehouses.

tools.name: shipmonk_list_orders
tools.description: List orders with status, store, items and shipping data. Filter by status, search text, or updated/shipped time windows. Returns one page per call; use page to continue. API: GET /v1/integrations/orders-list.

tools.name: shipmonk_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by its external order_key or its customer-facing order_number (at least one is required), optionally limited to a store_id. API: GET /v1/integrations/orders.

tools.name: shipmonk_list_products
tools.description: List products (SKUs) on the account with status, name and barcode. Filter by free text or by created/updated windows. Results can shift between pages while inventory moves. API: GET /v1/products.

tools.name: shipmonk_list_receivings
tools.description: List inbound receivings (purchase deliveries to a warehouse) by ASN, warehouse code, or created/updated time. API: GET /v1/integrations/receivings-list.

tools.name: shipmonk_get_receiving
tools.description: Get one receiving by its external receivingKey (e.g. a purchase order number) or by its ASN number (at least one is required). API: GET /v1/integrations/receiving.

tools.name: shipmonk_list_returns
tools.description: List customer returns (RMAs) by RMA number, status, warehouse, reason, desired action, or time window. API: GET /v1/integrations/returns-list.

tools.name: shipmonk_list_inventory_holds
tools.description: List inventory holds placed on ASNs (units kept from shipping), newest first, including released and cancelled holds. API: GET /v1/integrations/inventory-holds-list.

tools.name: shipmonk_create_order
tools.description: Create an order in ShipMonk, or update it when the same order_key and store_id already exist. Creating an order can start fulfilment: the order is only released when it is submitted (see shipmonk_submit_order). Confirm the items and address with the user first. API: POST /v1/integrations/order.

tools.name: shipmonk_submit_order
tools.description: Release an existing order into the warehouse fulfilment queue at submit_at (or reschedule its submit date). Once submitted, ShipMonk picks, packs and ships it: this moves physical goods. Confirm with the user first. API: POST /v1/integrations/submit-order.
